categories.title: Hide Reels
categories.detail: On: the Reels tab is removed and the Reels rail is cut from the feed. Off: both show as on Instagram.

categories.title: Hide Search and Explore
categories.detail: On: the Search tab is removed and the Explore grid stays hidden. Off: both show as on Instagram.

categories.title: Hide suggested posts
categories.detail: On: Suggested for you posts and account carousels are cut from the feed. Off: they show.

categories.title: Hide ads
categories.detail: On: Sponsored posts are cut from the feed and ad and tracking requests are blocked. Off: they show and load.

categories.title: Hide stories
categories.detail: On: the stories tray at the top of the feed is removed. Off: it shows.
